text:
maya: Heads up — spotted repeated Xid 79 + rising ECC counts on gpu-node-uw2-1783 after the last deploy. Looks like a long-tail flapper, not a one-off. Starting a short repro loop, pinging oncall.
rob: oncall here, thx. can you drop the node id and recent dmesg lines?
maya: node: gpu-node-uw2-1783. dmesg snippet: 
```
[  123.456789] NVRM: Xid (79): GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  123.456800] pcieport 0000:3b:00.0: AER: Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error received: id=0000
[  124.000100] EDAC MC0: CPU0 EDAC sbridge reported corrected error
```
rob: ok running nvml-smi loop and tailing syslog. starting a 1h memtester job on that GPU slot now.
joan: i can kick off a targeted diagnostic loop too — memtest + ecc-watch + sustained conv workload for ~6h. will tag results.
kyle: add PCIe link ping and kernel telemetry capture: `sudo journalctl -k -o short-precise -f | grep -i pcie` and dump lspci -vvv before/after.
alex: we should consider immediate drain if it reproduces quickly; uw2 capacity is ~76% but we can shift some batches to us-east.
maya: agree. i'll hold on final drain until one confirmed repro. for now set node to `quarantine` in fleet: `fleetctl set  gpu-node-uw2-1783 state=quarantine reason="repro-loop"`
rob: quick failure: memtester hit a single-bit ECC correction within 12m, then another at 27m. logging to bucket `infra-diagnostics/uw2/1945/`.
infra-bot: diagnostic-runner: started job diag-longtail-1945 for gpu-node-uw2-1783 (owner=joan) — logs -> s3://infra-diagnostics/uw2/1945/
joan: repro confirmed under stress conv job after ~2.5h; Xid 79 repeated and PCIe reset observed. I'm attaching the minimal repro script in the run logs.
kyle: thanks. next steps: schedule RMA or extended soak? my vote: RMA if same behavior appears across memtest+workload within 6h. if only memtest, maybe a driver bump first.
rob: agree — pattern suggests hardware. do we have spare capacity to pull this node out and run an extended soak on a spare slot while we RMA?
alex: we have 3 spare GPUs in uw2 pool tagged `repair-rotation`. can swap. i'm opening a repair ticket and tagging hw team.
maya: action list: 1) drain node if failure repros in next 6h (rob) 2) start 48h soak on spare slot with identical workload (joan) 3) collect full NVML and PCIe traces & put in ticket (kyle) 4) open RMA if >=2 reproducible Xid/ECC events across different diagnostics (alex).
rob: initiating `fleetctl drain gpu-node-uw2-1783 --reason "confirmed-xid79-repro"` now.
infra-bot: fleet: gpu-node-uw2-1783 state changed: active -> draining (by rob).
joan: starting soak run on spare: `./soak-run --gpu=uw2-spare-03 --script=conv_stress.sh --duration=48h --collect=nvml,pcie,dmesg`
maya: thanks team. please paste any odd telemetry in the ticket. i'll keep a rolling note in this thread. :white_check_mark:
